These security risks have been known for years but have never been satisfactorily addressed in many of the older Call of Duty titles (from BO1 to BO3). Anyone who launches the game nonetheless is exposing their entire PC and personal data to unnecessary risk.

It is unacceptable for a publisher like Activision to leave its players in such insecure environments. As long as these exploits have not been officially and permanently patched, installing this game poses a massive security risk.

Please research the topic “CoD RCE exploit” yourself before launching the game. I have permanently uninstalled the game due to these security concerns.
